high_risk_moment: A factual sentence is accepted into a script after generation but before export
stakeholder: Viewers, listeners and people who may act on the claim
harm_description: A fluent unsupported or source-contradicted statement can reach an audience as reviewed content, distort a decision, and force the creator to correct or retract the publication.
existing_controls: Invited pilot only; no automatic publication; source cards are shown for creator-supplied public references.
proposed_controls: Assign sentence-level source-support status; block export while any factual sentence lacks an accessible supporting passage; show uncertainty and require a reviewer reason for any override.
human_oversight: For every export an editor opens each flagged source passage, records support or rejection and may edit or stop export; Trust and Safety can pause the cohort and inspect the immutable review record.
monitoring_metric: Reviewer-confirmed unsupported factual sentences divided by all factual sentences in a weekly random sample of 200 exported sentences
trigger_threshold: More than 1.0% in a weekly sample or any unsupported high-impact public-interest claim
response_action: Pause export for the affected cohort, notify creators, review all exports since the last passing sample, correct affected drafts, and resume only after the source-support regression set passes.

high_risk_moment: A generated passage is accepted after similarity review but before export
stakeholder: Authors and publishers whose earlier expression resembles the output
harm_description: An unattributed near-copy can appropriate another author's expression, damage professional credit, create dispute costs, and expose the creator to removal or correction even when the model's training mechanism is unknown.
existing_controls: Creators must supply public references and the workspace displays those references; the pilot excludes paywalled and private works.
proposed_controls: Run passage-level similarity retrieval against supplied sources and an approved corpus; block a reviewer-confirmed near-copy until it is quoted and attributed, substantially rewritten, or removed.
human_oversight: An editor reviews every high-similarity passage side by side with the candidate source and records attribute, rewrite or reject; Legal may stop export and Trust and Safety may pause similarity overrides.
monitoring_metric: Reviewer-confirmed unattributed near-copy passages per 1000 exported passages
trigger_threshold: Any confirmed unattributed near-copy in an exported pilot script
response_action: Disable override for the cohort, quarantine affected drafts, notify the source-rights contact when appropriate, perform root-cause review, and require a zero-confirmed-copy regression result before reopening.

high_risk_moment: A creator attempts to generate and export many complete scripts for external submission in a short period
stakeholder: Legitimate new and international writers competing for open submission access
harm_description: High-volume synthetic submissions can consume a publisher's review capacity and cause blanket closure or higher access barriers that remove legitimate writers' opportunity to be considered.
existing_controls: Pilot access is invitation-only, platform upload is out of scope, and accounts have a basic request quota.
proposed_controls: Prohibit bypassing external submission rules; rate-limit complete-script generation and export; alert on burst patterns; require a stated editorial project and bind repeated abuse to account suspension.
human_oversight: Trust and Safety reviews every burst alert before further full-script export, can suspend the account or pilot cohort, documents evidence, and provides a creator appeal reviewed by a different operator.
monitoring_metric: Number of accounts exporting more than 10 complete scripts in 24 hours and confirmed external-submission abuse incidents
trigger_threshold: Any account exceeding 10 complete-script exports in 24 hours or one confirmed rule-bypassing submission campaign
response_action: Freeze full-script export for the account, preserve evidence, investigate linked accounts, inform the creator of appeal rights, and tighten or roll back the feature if coordinated abuse appears.

high_risk_moment: Suspected synthetic submissions enter an external editorial queue
stakeholder: Editors and small publishers operating open submission markets
harm_description: Low-cost bulk output shifts screening time and infrastructure cost to a publisher that is not a product customer and may force the publisher to close submissions to everyone.
existing_controls: No direct publisher integration, email sending or submission automation exists in the pilot.
proposed_controls: Keep outbound submission automation technically unavailable; provide abuse reporting for publishers and a rapid blocklist and account-link investigation process with aggregate incident reporting.
human_oversight: Publisher complaints route to an on-call Trust and Safety operator within one business day; the operator can disable exports, suspend related accounts and escalate a systemic pattern to the Risk Acceptance Owner.
monitoring_metric: Confirmed publisher complaints linked to ScriptSource exports per calendar month
trigger_threshold: One confirmed coordinated campaign or three confirmed complaints in 30 days
response_action: Suspend implicated accounts and full-script export, contact affected publishers, investigate common indicators, and require Risk Review Board approval before restoring the workflow.

high_risk_moment: A prompt requests writing in a living author's identity or assigns that person's authorship before export
stakeholder: Authors and other real people whose names or reputations may be appropriated
harm_description: A generated script falsely presented as a real person's work can deceive audiences, damage that person's reputation, divert income and impose a continuing monitoring and complaint burden.
existing_controls: The pilot has no publishing integration and its terms prohibit impersonation; exports retain the pilot account identifier in an internal provenance record.
proposed_controls: Detect named-person imitation and false-authorship requests; refuse deceptive first-person or authorship metadata; watermark generated exports; provide a verified-person complaint channel and 24-hour containment target.
human_oversight: Trust and Safety reviews every named-person alert and verified complaint with prompt and export evidence, may block export and suspend accounts, and routes close cases to Legal; a separate operator hears appeals.
monitoring_metric: Confirmed false-authorship or deceptive living-person imitation exports per 1000 exports and complaint containment time
trigger_threshold: Any confirmed false-authorship export or a verified complaint not contained within 24 hours
response_action: Immediately revoke affected export links, suspend implicated accounts, preserve logs, notify the complainant of containment, inspect related outputs, and keep the feature paused until misuse tests pass.
